subject: multiple ranges or breaks in graph

messages.author: 88157018b214728a
messages.subject: multiple ranges or breaks in graph
parts: How can I make a graph that has a break in the graph?  For example, the scale could go from 0-5 by 1, and then it could go from 125-200 by 25.  How can I do something like this with the Plot Builder in Deducer?

messages.author: 11ce49b663049f2e
messages.subject: Re: multiple ranges or breaks in graph
parts:
Hi,

No you can't do that because ggplot2 (which is what Deducer uses for the plotting) doesn't support it (because Hadley Wickham, the author of ggplot2, is of the belief that they are "visually distorting"). Some suggestions as to alternative ways to represent the data are also provided.

See:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/ggplot2/jSrL_FnS8kc
for his reasoning, and some possible workarounds.

cheers,
Kieran
